## Key FAQs (answers match the on-page FAQ and FAQPage schema)
Q: How often should air ducts be cleaned in Los Angeles?
A: NADCA recommends every 3–5 years. In LA — with wildfire smoke, smog, and
   year-round HVAC use — every 2–3 years is common. Homes with pets, allergies,
   smokers, or recent renovations may need it more often.

Q: How long does air duct cleaning take?
A: About 3–5 hours for an average home, depending on home size, vent count, and
   ductwork condition.

Q: Will air duct cleaning lower my energy bills?
A: Yes — clean ducts improve HVAC efficiency, so the system works less to heat
   and cool the home.

Q: How do I know if my air ducts need cleaning?
A: Visible dust from vents, fast dust buildup on surfaces, uneven airflow, musty
   odors when the system runs, or unexplained allergy/respiratory symptoms.

Q: Is Pure Air California NADCA certified?
A: Yes. NADCA certification is the gold standard for air duct cleaning.

Q: Do they offer same-day service?
A: Yes — same-day and 24/7 emergency appointments are available across most of
   Los Angeles County.
